text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered — prod-serving pool 'redwood-prod-gpu-1' showing repeated container restarts (crashloop) for runtime image rwinf/runtime:2.8. Backoff threshold hit on multiple nodes. Paging oncall.

oncall-ryan: I'm on it, ack. Looking at k8s events now.

sara: saw the alert, noticed high OOM+segfault pattern on pods serving model 'gptx-13b-quant'.

ops-bot: Recent event excerpt:
```
Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
----     ------     ----  ----               -------
Warning  BackOff    1m    kubelet, node-07   Back-off restarting failed container
Normal   Killing    30s   kubelet, node-07   Container rwinf-runtime terminated with exit code 139
Warning  OOMKilled  10s   kubelet, node-09   Pod terminated: process out of memory
```

jia: grabbing logs from pod runtime-57b4:
```
kubectl logs runtime-57b4 -c runtime --since=5m
[2026-08-12T14:02:23Z] runtime: cuda kernel launch failed: unspecified launch failure (cudaErrorLaunchFailure)
[2026-08-12T14:02:23Z] runtime: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f4a3b2a12f0 sp 0x7ffeefbffb90 error 4 in rwinf-runtime[7f4a39000000+1a0000]
[2026-08-12T14:02:23Z] runtime: backtrace (most recent call first):
  0x7f4a3b2a12f0 in fused_kernel+0x2b0
  0x7f4a3b1c0faa in kv_cache_write+0x5a
  0x7f4a3b1b9d2 in forward_pass+0x1d2
```

mike: segfault + cuda launch failure suggests a kernel race or bad tensor shape in fused kernel. Was there a recent runtime image roll?

oncall-ryan: yes, we rolled rwinf/runtime:2.8 two hours ago with fused-kernel optimizations. Canary passed on small traffic but looks like production traffic hitting different execution path.

anna: I'm seeing node flaps — nodes node-07 and node-09 reported GPU driver resets around same timeframe. dmesg excerpt from node-09 shows NVML reset trace.

jia: quick mitigation options:
- roll back runtime image to 2.7 on the pool (fast).
- drain/cordon affected nodes to stop scheduling and mitigate noise.
- force fallback to baseline model variant (gptx-13b-fp16) without fused kernels via config override.

ops-bot: customer impact estimate: 2 enterprise customers affected (latency spikes, 5-8% request failures), general API error rate bumped from 0.4% -> 6% in the last 7m.

oncall-ryan: doing rollback to runtime:2.7 on 'redwood-prod-gpu-1' now. Executing rollout: ``kubectl set image deployment/serving-runtime rwinf-runtime=rwinf/runtime:2.7 -n prod``

sara: also opening temporary routing rule to divert new requests to 'redwood-prod-gpu-2' which is running older runtime and lower utilization.

mike: I'm attaching a small repro script to exercise the fused kernel path — will run on staging with same batch shapes to try reproduce. If we can consistently trigger, we can produce a minimal reproducer for the runtime team.

oncall-ryan: rollback initiated. Rolling pods terminating and new pods coming up. Tracking restart counts.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement: Incident P1 - assigned to oncall-ryan. Estimated priority window 60m.

anna: after rollback, node-09 still shows dmesg GPU reset, but new runtime pods on node-07 are stable so far. Node-09 might be hardware/driver related; I'll isolate it.

ops-bot: current status update (T+18m):
- Rollback to runtime:2.7 progressing, 6/10 pods updated.
- Error rate reduced to 2.1% (from 6%).
- Two customers still experiencing occasional failures (observability links: https://console/redwood/incidents/2833337000)

jia: mitigation checklist I'm executing:
1) complete image rollback on the pool.
2) cordon node-09, drain if necessary.
3) force traffic split off canary-route -> baseline.
4) capture full core dumps of failing container(s) for debugging.

sara: commands I'm running now:
```
kubectl cordon node-09
kubectl drain node-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=serving-runtime -o wide
```

mike: log note: i attached gdb bt from a coredump we captured on a dev repro run:
```
#0  0x00007f4a3b2a12f0 in fused_kernel(void*) at fused_kernel.cu:412
#1  0x00007f4a3b1c0faa in kv_cache_write at kv_cache.cu:88
#2  0x00007f4a3b1b9d2 in forward_pass at runtime.cpp:1021
```
Looks like an unchecked nullptr in the fused kernel when batch size dims mismatch on last token.

oncall-ryan: handoff: i'm staying on for next 30m to ensure rollback completes and error rate returns to baseline. After that, please escalate to runtime-team if we have reproduction.

anna: node-09 cordoned and drain started — evicting pods. I'll schedule an infra ticket to check GPU firmware/driver mismatch.

ops-bot: incoming customer message: "We're seeing intermittent 500s for embeddings generation since 14:02 UTC." Customer TL;DR: degraded experience, no data loss. CS informed.

mike: adding runtime-team triage tasks: reproduce on staging + attach repro + kernel patch attempt (bounds-check). I'll open a PR if we have a small fix.

sara: rollback finished. All pods on redwood-prod-gpu-1 are now at runtime:2.7. Error rate back to 0.6%. Customer impact reduced to background — CS will follow up with affected customers.

oncall-ryan: final handoff to mike (runtime-team lead) for full root cause and postmortem. I'll update PagerDuty and remove paging.

mike: ack, picking up RCA. Initial hypothesis: fused kernel in 2.8 lacks a defensive check leading to segfault under production batch-shape distribution; driver resets on node-09 amplified failures. Will coordinate with infra to validate node health.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged resolved state: mitigated (rollback + node isolation). Postmortem tracking ID: PM-2026-08-12-34.

ops-bot: Next steps assigned:
- mike: reproduce + PR or revert kernel change (runtime).
- anna: node health/driver check + firmware upgrade if needed (infra).
- sara: customer comms + internal incident doc.
- jia: attach core dumps + telemetry to postmortem.

mike: ETA for preliminary RCA: 24-48h. Will post updates in this thread.

sara: added incident summary to docs, linking logs and timelines. Great work team. :thumbsup:

oncall-ryan: closing my oncall shift. Leaving notes in rotation.

ops-bot: incident thread closed for active mitigation; thread will remain for RCA follow-up. :eyes:
